verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Speak to the children of Israel, that they turn back and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, before Baal Zephon. You shall encamp opposite it by the sea. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Faraon will say of the children of Israel, ‘They are entangled in the țară. The wilderness has shut them in.’

I will harden Faraon’s heart, and he will follow after them; and I will get honor over Faraon, and over all his armies; and the Egiptians shall know that Eu sunt the DOMNUL. They did so. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The king of Egipt was told that the people had fled; and the heart of Faraon and of his servants was changed toward the people, and they a zis, What is this we have done, that we have let Israel să plece from serving us?
He prepared his chariot, and took his army with him; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egipt, with captains over all of them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL hardened the heart of Faraon king of Egipt, and he pursued the children of Israel; for the children of Israel went out with a high mână.

The Egiptians pursued them. All the horses and chariots of Faraon, his horsemen, and his army overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baal Zephon. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

When Faraon came near, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egiptians were marching after them; and they were very afraid. The children of Israel cried out to the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

They i-a zis lui Moise, Because there were no graves in Egipt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? Why have you treated us this way, to bring us out of Egipt? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Isn’t this the word that we a vorbit lui you in Egipt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egiptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egiptians than to die in the wilderness. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise i-a zis lui the people, Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of the DOMNUL, which he will work for you today; for you will never again see the Egiptians whom you have seen today. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL will fight for you, and you shall be still. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Why do you cry to me? Speak to the children of Israel, that they să plece forward.
Lift up your rod, and întinde your mână over the sea and divide it. Then the children of Israel shall să plece into the middle of the sea on dry ground.
Behold, I myself will harden the hearts of the Egiptians, and they will să plece in after them. I will get myself honor over Faraon, and over all his armies, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.
The Egiptians shall know that Eu sunt the DOMNUL when I have să plecetten myself honor over Faraon, over his chariots, and over his horsemen.

The angel of Dumnezeu, who went before the camp of Israel, moved and went behind them; and the pillar of cloud moved from before them, and stood behind them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

It came between the camp of Egipt and the camp of Israel. There was the cloud and the darkness, yet it gave light by night. One didn’t come near the other all night. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise stretched out his mână over the sea, and the DOMNUL caused the sea to să plece back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry țară, and the waters were divided.
The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground; and the waters were a wall to them on their right mână and on their left.
The Egiptians pursued, and went in after them into the middle of the sea: all of Faraon’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
In the morning watch, the DOMNUL looked out on the Egiptian army through the pillar of fire and of cloud, and confused the Egiptian army. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egiptians a zis, Let’s flee from the face of Israel, for the DOMNUL fights for them against the Egiptians! (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Stretch out your mână over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egiptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.

Moise stretched out his mână over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egiptians fled against it. The DOMNUL overthrew the Egiptians in the middle of the sea.

The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Faraon’s army that went in after them into the sea. There remained not so much as one of them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
But the children of Israel walked on dry țară in the middle of the sea, and the waters were a wall to them on their right mână and on their left.
Thus the DOMNUL saved Israel that day out of the mână of the Egiptians; and Israel saw the Egiptians dead on the seashore.

Israel saw the great work which the DOMNUL did to the Egiptians, and the people feared the DOMNUL; and they believed in the DOMNUL and in his servant Moise. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
